note: MOVING TO GODOT. I was wrong that a real engine couldn't work in this container — I proved Godot 4.3 runs here with its FORWARD+ renderer on software Vulkan (lavapipe), rendering shadows, glow, SSAO, volumetric fog and ACES tonemapping, and saving frames in ~11s. So the build→play→screenshot→critique loop works in Godot too, and Forward+ gives real global illumination / SSAO / volumetric fog that I could never hand-roll in WebGL. Rebuilding the game there. The three.js build (overall 9.0) stays intact as the reference to beat.

log.msg: Engine pivot: proved Godot 4.3 runs in this container with the FORWARD+ renderer on software Vulkan (lavapipe) — shadows, glow, SSAO, volumetric fog, ACES — and saves frames in ~11s, so the critic loop works there too. Correcting my earlier claim that a real engine couldn't run here. Rebuilding the game in Godot; the three.js build stays as the bar to beat.

Carl rebuilt on a real rigged glTF skeleton and (per your call) BEEFED into a muscular bearded barbarian via a bone-parented muscle suit — real skeletal idle/walk/run + axe chop AND heroic identity. Big fidelity jump vs primitives. Committed. Overall 8.8 → 9.0.
First rigged Carl was a slim/blank mannequin — a lateral move, not a clear win. Surfaced the tradeoff to you; you chose 'beef him up', so we kept the real rig + bulked him muscular.
Spaced the demo's auto loot-box ceremony way out (was hogging the screen every ~9s) so the demo shows actual gameplay. Real game still opens boxes on 'o'.
Stage 2: testing Carl on a real rigged glTF skeleton (Xbot base) — skeletal idle/walk/run, axe on the hand bone.
Render overhaul VERIFIED after one send-back: moodier than before AND PBR surfaces now benefit from image-based lighting. Overall 8.6 → 8.8. Committed.

First IBL attempt regressed the mood (too bright/flat, crystals desaturated). Critic sent it back with old-vs-new frames; builder restored deep blacks + glowing crystals while keeping IBL as reflection fill.
Render-pipeline builder: image-based lighting (PMREM/RoomEnvironment) + real post stack (UnrealBloom + FXAA + ACES + vignette).

De-risked the approach: fetched real rigged glTF models (Soldier/Xbot/Robot/Fox) + HDRIs from the one reachable host, vendored the glTF/HDRI/postFX loaders, and proved a skinned model + IBL + bloom renders clean headless. Committed the asset pipeline.

User: 'make the visuals much better — maybe a different platform?' → Verdict: keep three.js (only engine our critic loop can drive headless here); the lever is real assets + pipeline. Hybrid chosen: Carl/Donut/Juicer keep their identity on real rigged bases.
